criteria.name: Consultas
criteria.hypothesis: With 100,000 synthetic metrics keyed by game_id and metric_name#timestamp, at 1,000 requests/second, at least 95% of game/time-range reads use Query rather than Scan and achieve p95 below 20 ms in AWS.
criteria.validation: Run representative game/time-range requests against an AWS table and record Query/Scan usage and p95 latency.

criteria.name: Escala
criteria.hypothesis: In on-demand mode, increasing load from 100 to 1,000 requests/second for 15 minutes keeps throttling below 0.1% and p95 below 20 ms.
criteria.validation: Run a synthetic ramp test and capture CloudWatch capacity, throttling, errors, and latency.

criteria.name: Consistencia
criteria.hypothesis: For 1,000 PutItem then strongly consistent base-table reads, every acknowledged value is observed by the next GetItem or Query; GSI reads are measured separately as eventual.
criteria.validation: Repeat write/read cycles with ConsistentRead enabled on the base table and compare behavior with a GSI.

criteria.name: Costo
criteria.hypothesis: For 1 million 1 KB writes, 10 million 1 KB reads, and 10 GB stored per month in us-east-1, the AWS Pricing Calculator estimate is below USD 25/month, excluding free tier, streams, and auxiliary services.
criteria.validation: Save the calculator inputs and exported estimate; revise the score if the estimate exceeds budget.

criteria.name: Fallos y recuperacion
criteria.hypothesis: During a 10-minute test injecting 1% throttling, timeout, and 5xx errors, bounded exponential retries with jitter complete at least 99.9% of operations without duplicate external IDs.
criteria.validation: Inject transient faults through a test proxy or SDK stub and verify completion rate, retry bounds, and idempotency.

candidates.name: MongoDB
candidates.rationale: Flexible documents fit variable payloads, but current access patterns are stable key/time queries and add an extra operational engine.

candidates.name: Neo4j
candidates.rationale: Native relationship traversal is valuable for path and network queries, which are not the current metrics workload.

candidates.name: Apache Cassandra
candidates.rationale: Excellent partitioned write scale, with query-by-partition design and cluster operations that are not justified for the current team scope.

candidates.name: Amazon DynamoDB
candidates.rationale: Managed key-based Query aligns with game/time access patterns and on-demand capacity; base-table strong reads are available, while GSI reads are eventual.

candidates.name: Amazon S3
candidates.rationale: Strong for durable, low-cost object archival, but not the primary store for low-latency per-game metric queries.

selectionScope: Complementary operational metrics/events store; PostgreSQL remains the relational source of truth.
